mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stat_user_subject (user_id, subject_id, answered_count, correct_count, accuracy, mastery, last_answered_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{subjectId}, #{answeredDelta}, #{correctDelta}, IF(#{answeredDelta} = 0, 0, #{correctDelta} / #{answeredDelta}), #{masteryPrior}, #{answeredAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE answered_count = answered_count + VALUES(answered_count), correct_count = correct_count + VALUES(correct_count), accuracy = IF(answered_count = 0, 0, correct_count / answered_count), last_answered_at = VALUES(last_answered_at)

INSERT INTO stat_user_subject (user_id, subject_id, mastery, answered_count, correct_count, accuracy) VALUES (#{userId}, #{subjectId}, #{mastery}, 0, 0, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE mastery = VALUES(mastery)

INSERT INTO stat_user_subject (user_id, subject_id, exam_count, best_score) VALUES (#{userId}, #{subjectId}, 1, #{score}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE exam_count = exam_count + 1, best_score = GREATEST(COALESCE(best_score, 0), VALUES(best_score))
